original_value: We introduce a digital pseudo-differential operator acting in discrete Sobolev--Slobodetskii spaces and consider pseudo-differential equations with such operators in a discrete half-space. The theorem on a general solution of such equations is proved for a special case.

result.paraphrase: We introduce a digital pseudo-differential operator acting on discrete Sobolev–Slobodetskii spaces and study pseudo-differential equations with these operators in a discrete half-space. A theorem giving the general solution of such equations is established for a special case.
